title: Delta audition modes, processBlock wiring, CMakeLists
description:
Fan-in task: wire A/B crossfade + gain-matched bypass, profile/tuning selection, factory preset discovery, and delta (removed-signal) audition into PluginProcessor/PluginEditor, and register phase-K sources in CMakeLists.txt. Sole owner of Source/PluginProcessor.*, Source/PluginEditor.cpp, and CMakeLists.txt in phase K per async_notes.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §14.1–14.3 (A/B, gain match, delta audition modes: full removed signal, selected band only, all dynamic reductions, resonance suppressor, sidechain carve only, Tight Cut removal, Chug Stabilizer removal)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.2 header controls (A/B, gain-matched audition, profile/tuning, presets)
- Source/StateManager.* A/B + GainMatch APIs from k.1
- Source/Profiles.* catalogs from k.2
- Resources/Presets/* from k.3
- Existing removed-signal / listenRemoved taps on TightCut, Chug, ResonanceSuppressor, dynamic bands, MaskingCarver if present
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp prepare/processBlock order from phases G–J
- Source/PluginEditor.* header controls from j.5
- CMakeLists.txt append / juce_add_binary_data patterns from prior phases

Implement RejectedSignalRouter (may live as nested class or helper inside PluginProcessor files if a separate DSP file is not in allowed paths — keep symbols in allowed processor files only):
1. Enum DeltaAuditionMode covering §14.3 modes plus Off.
2. RT-safe select: when mode≠Off, replace or blend main output with the corresponding removed-signal buffer (y_removed = x - y_processed or module-provided removed tap). Modes that lack a tap available idle to silence or dry with documented fallback — never deallocate.
3. Mutual exclusion with ordinary wet path; no double gain; true Off restores normal processing output.

PluginProcessor.h/.cpp wiring:
1. Own/ensure StateManager member; prepare GainMatch meter; each processBlock push pre-EQ/post-EQ (or in/out) levels into match meter; apply G_match as a temporary trim on bypass/audition path when gain-matched bypass enabled — freeze match while A/B crossfade active.
2. A/B: on abState/param or StateManager switch, apply target slot and run click-safe equal-power/linear crossfade of dry-versus-pending or previous-versus-new output over 5–30 ms using StateManager helpers; no zipper.
3. Profile/tuning: read profileIndex/tuningIndex (and custom tuning if stored); expose getActivePlacement()/getActiveTuning() for editor/NoteRuler; applyPlacementDefaults only on explicit user/profile-load action, not every block.
4. Factory presets: ensure StateManager can see Resources/Presets path or BinaryData; load APIs remain message-thread.
5. Delta audition: parameter or processor setter setDeltaAuditionMode; wire module removed taps into RejectedSignalRouter at end of chain before outputGain as appropriate; honor globalBypass.
6. Do not rewrite upstream DSP algorithms beyond member wiring and parameter plumbing.

PluginEditor.cpp (and only .cpp unless header already exposes needed members — prefer .cpp-only edits; if a declaration is mandatory, keep changes minimal and still within allowed_write_paths which lists PluginEditor.cpp only — use existing header hooks from j.5):
1. Wire header A/B switch, copy A→B, gain-matched bypass toggle, profile selector, tuning selector, preset browser to StateManager/Profiles/APVTS.
2. Wire delta audition mode control (combo or buttons) to processor RejectedSignalRouter modes.
3. No full UI redesign; extend existing j.5 header controls.

CMakeLists.txt:
1. Append Source/StateManager.cpp if not already present; append Source/Profiles.cpp.
2. Ensure Resources/Presets factory JSON are installed or registered via juce_add_binary_data / target resource copy — minimal append-only pattern matching the repo.
3. Append tests/StateTests.cpp to the unit-test target (k.5 owns test body).
4. No preset/target rename churn.

Do not implement unit test bodies. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: PluginProcessor wires StateManager A/B switch with click-safe crossfade and gain-matched bypass trim that freezes during comparison switching
RejectedSignalRouter or equivalent supports Off plus §14.3 delta audition modes and is selectable from the processor
profileIndex/tuningIndex connect to Profiles catalog; factory presets under Resources/Presets are discoverable for load
PluginEditor.cpp header controls wire A/B, gain-match, profile/tuning, presets, and delta audition without redesigning the whole UI
CMakeLists.txt lists Source/Profiles.cpp and tests/StateTests.cpp and registers/preserves factory preset resources
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite Source/StateManager.* APIs beyond call-site usage
modify tests/StateTests.cpp body beyond CMake listing
redesign entire PluginEditor layout from phase J

allowed: equal-power or linear A/B output crossfade 5–30 ms
juce_add_binary_data or runtime path load for factory presets
forbidden: silent permanent outputGain automation from match meter
